pages.alt: Anthlan warns everyone about the button. Drachenherz presses it anyway and triggers zombie waves. Anthlan repeats the warning and locks a safety cover. DaVinci1986 spots the key.
pages.description: Anthlan warns everyone about the button. Drachenherz presses it anyway and triggers zombie waves. Anthlan repeats the warning and locks a safety cover. DaVinci1986 spots the key.
dialogue: Do not press! It starts 20 zombie waves!
Maybe it is different the second time?

pages.alt: DaVinci1986 opens the cover and tests the button. More zombie waves arrive. Anthlan repeats his warning, chains the cover shut and keeps the key. Helltrain examines the base.
pages.description: DaVinci1986 opens the cover and tests the button. More zombie waves arrive. Anthlan repeats his warning, chains the cover shut and keeps the key. Helltrain examines the base.
dialogue: A chain this time. The key stays with me!

pages.alt: Helltrain unscrews the chained cover and presses. After the third zombie attack, Anthlan bolts a protective cage in place. Somea still wants a turn. Anthlan carries her away, looking exasperated, while mysteryZ gets him coffee.

dialogue: For the third time: DO NOT press!
Please please let me press it too
Poor Anthlan. I will get coffee.
